dash.cli_hint: Also works in your system terminal (e.g. career status) — same binary as this window.
onb.title: Getting started
onb.profile: Import your resume (PDF) to build your profile
onb.ai: Configure the AI — free Ollama on your PC or an API key
onb.jobs: Search for jobs to fill your list
onb.queue: Review what the system prepared in the queue
err.title: Could not load this screen
config.title: Settings
config.sub: Everything the system can use is listed here — the first sections cover the basics; the rest lives under Advanced.
config.hint: Edits write to the .env file in your data folder. Passwords and keys show masked — type a new value to change.
config.import_paste: …or paste an .env content here (KEY=value per line)
config.import_empty: Pick a file or paste the content first.
jobs.title: Jobs found
jobs.sub: Everything the system found so far — mark what already happened or clean what you don't want.
queue.sub: What is waiting for your decision — the system never sends without your review under the configured mode.
vault.title: Passwords & credentials
vault.sub: Logins the automation uses on your behalf (e-mail for sending, job-site accounts). Stored encrypted — the list only shows names.
vault.empty: No credentials yet — add your e-mail one to send applications through it.
vault.bad_json: the text is not valid JSON
profile.title: My profile
profile.sub: The master profile is the résumé summary the AI uses to score jobs and tailor documents — nothing enters it except from your CV or your edits.
profile.steps: Steps: 1) pick your résumé PDF and click Import  2) run 'Generate draft'  3) review the draft below and click 'Approve'.
profile.no_master: No profile yet — import your résumé PDF.
runtime.title: System components
runtime.sub: Extra pieces the executable needs to browse job sites and read documents — downloaded only once.
runtime.all_ok_desc: Every component is in place — nothing to do here.
runtime.missing_desc: Click to download and install what's missing (needs internet; may take a few minutes).
term.title: Run
term.sub: What the system does: search jobs, prepare applications, review what's missing. Tap an action — the output appears below.
term.input_hint: If the command asks something (password, yes/no), answer here and tap Send.
action.discover.desc: Finds new jobs on configured sources and saves to the list
action.discover_dry.desc: Shows what it would find, without saving
action.run.desc: AI triage + résumé tailoring + review queue
action.run.confirm: This prepares real applications — high-score jobs may be sent per your execution mode. Continue?
action.run_dry.desc: Same pipeline, without sending or saving
action.review.desc: Opens the interactive review of what needs you
action.retry.desc: Redoes the submission of jobs that asked for you
action.retry.confirm: This reopens submission of pending jobs — answer prompts in the output below. Continue?
action.import.desc: Reads the PDFs you sent in the Profile tab
action.approve.desc: Promotes the draft to the official profile
action.config_check.desc: Tests AI provider, e-mail and paths
